name: preflight
description: A live pre-commit checklist above the prompt: re-runs your typecheck, lint or any command after Claude edits files.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Semicolon-separated name=command pairs, e.g. types=npx tsc -b;lint=npm run lint. Empty: auto-detect (tsc if tsconfig.json exists, npm run lint if defined).

delaySeconds.title: Wait after last edit (s)
delaySeconds.description: How long to wait after the last file edit before running the checks.

githubOnly.title: Only in GitHub repositories
githubOnly.description: Show this bar only when the session folder is a git repository whose remote is on GitHub. Turn off to show it in any git repository.
